name: figma-cursor
title: Figma Cursor
description: Three labelled cursors in blue, pink and green move slowly along looping paths over a mock design. Each pill carries a name and an arrow, like collaborators in a shared editing tool.
use: A demo needs to suggest live collaborators or multiplayer presence on a shared canvas.
avoid: It is decorative only; the cursors are fake and follow no real pointer or user.
a11y: Decorative motion with no control; it ignores reduced-motion and keeps looping for everyone. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three rounded name pills in blue, pink and green, each paired with a small matching pointer arrow, floating over a dark canvas that holds two outlined mock frames.
behaves: Each pill and arrow drifts along its own short looping path, moving right and down then back again. The motion repeats forever on timers of roughly four to five seconds.
customise: Pass text plus optional colour, stroke, pixel offsets, duration and delay. Path shape and the endless loop are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Three small pills and arrows moved by transform on a repeat timer; cheap to run.
